name: independent-review
description: Independent Claude and Codex review loops for GitHub pull requests and local code changes.

interface.shortDescription: Cross-session code review and fix loops
interface.longDescription: Run a read-only Claude or fresh Codex reviewer against a verified Git diff, validate findings locally, and apply only proven minimal fixes. The Codex loop triages findings and re-reviews only the delta for at most three rounds.
defaultPrompt: Use $claude-review to independently review this PR.
